I changed `tax` in `src/invoice.py` so it rounds half up to the cent, as FIN-12 requires. The old code used `math.floor`, which gave 10.12 for this input.

- **Fix:** the amount and rate go through `Decimal`, so $112.50 \times 0.09 = 10.125$ rounds to 10.13. Floating-point error can't push it to 10.12.
- **Test:** unchanged. It already encodes the FIN-12 expectation.
- **Not verified:** I can't run the suite, so CI is the first check. I traced the arithmetic by hand only.

One behavior change to be aware of: other callers of `tax` will now get half-up rounding instead of floor. I didn't search for other callers, since I only have list and read access to the repo.
